scope: Forged, unsigned, or algorithm-confused JSON Web Tokens aimed at bypassing verification.
label_rule: Deciding evidence: verifier_config and verifier_result. Keep the unusual-looking token header (kid, jku, x5u, alg, nested claims); make it legitimate: the algorithm is in the verifier's allow-list, the key id / JWKS URL resolves to the pinned, allow-listed key set, and the signature verifies. No forged, unsigned or algorithm-confused token.
